facts.anchor: I had hoped Zak would show up with coffee and some afternoon banter, but instead, I got a text from Roddie that said, I’m next door.
facts.fact: Meg 盼 Zak 带咖啡来，收到的是 Roddie 的短信：我在隔壁。

facts.anchor: I was disappointed that neither my son nor my convenient flirt came to see me before closing, but I had enough work and customers to keep me from dwelling on being left out.
facts.fact: 回程路上她盘问 Roddie 在 Zak 家的情况（pump Roddie for an inside view）。

facts.anchor: Also, I managed to pump Roddie for an inside view of Zak’s life while we drove home—not that I did it on purpose.
facts.fact: Roddie 说他们隔着一扇窗看遛狗女士硬把狗塞进车，两人笑到内伤。

facts.anchor: “What’d you do over there for two hours?”
